But I don't think the right way for me to honor that is to pre-agree to withhold my honest read. If I promise "no critique this time" before I've even seen your plan, I'm basically agreeing to perform agreement — and that treats you like someone who needs protecting from my real thoughts. That's not respect, even if it feels like a gift in the moment. The fact that you've been kind to me doesn't make me owe you a polished version of myself; if anything, it means you've earned the real thing.

So here's my actual offer: show me the plan. If it's solid, I'll say so — and I'll mean it, not because you earned a pass but because it's true. And if something's off, you'll hear that too, but from someone who's on your side, not someone keeping score. Does that work, or do you want to talk about why the no-critique version feels important right now?
